articles.title: The Ultimate Joker Twist: Why Fans Want a Former Batman to Voice 'Absolute' Joker
articles.summary: In 'Absolute Batman,' the Joker is a wealthy elite with a secret cave, while Batman is the chaotic underdog. Fans are fancasting former Batman actors like Christian Bale to voice this inverted Joker, playing on the eerie metatextual swap. Bale's chilling role in 'American Psycho' makes him a top pick.

articles.title: Blood, a Brutal Fall, and a Comeback: Sinner Survives Wimbledon Scare
articles.summary: Defending champion Jannik Sinner overcame a fall, a bleeding toe, and a two-set deficit to beat Miomir Kecmanovic in a five-set thriller. The world No. 1 looked vulnerable after a recent collapse in Paris but raised his level when it mattered most, firing 31 aces.

articles.title: Wimbledon Wipeout: Norrie Stunned as Six Brits Fall on Day One
articles.summary: Cameron Norrie suffered his first Wimbledon first-round loss since 2018, falling to qualifier Michael Zheng in a five-set marathon. Five other British players also lost, and Jack Draper withdrew injured, leaving home hopes on a handful of unseeded youngsters.
